answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 164063 Country: India Title: Namaaz with half sleeves shirt Question: I have read that offering salah with half sleeves shirt is makrooh. So my question is when people go for hajj they wear ihram and in that one hand is not fully covered, it is like half sleeve. So as per the jurist whether the namaz is makrooh or not? Answer ID: 164063 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1275/1140/SD=11/1439) The clothes of Ihram with open sleeves are proved from sunnah. There is no harm in offering salah in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
